description: mini-run-guard (remote runner add-on; inactive unless configured): denies heavy Bash commands (tsc, builds, full test suites) under the configured scope root and names the exact `mini-run <cmd>` to use. Escape: COS_ALLOW_LOCAL_HEAVY=1 or `# local-ok: <reason>`. cos-heartbeat: chief-spawned workers (env COS_WORKER) touch $COS_HEARTBEAT_DIR/<worker> on every tool call / turn end (zero tokens). cos-ck: the exact prompt ⟦CK⟧ in a worker injects the check-in protocol (protocols/ck.md).
